business_problem: Audio algorithms designed for quiet conference rooms did not perform reliably in real-world environments with wind, reverberation, and ambient noise, degrading audio quality and speech-to-text recognition in Insta360 products.
solution_summary: Insta360 and Tencent Cloud co-developed audio processing for the Wave Professional AI Speakerphone to improve clarity in noisy home and outdoor environments. Insta360 selected Tencent Ethereal Audio Lab after evaluating more than a dozen providers; Tencent Cloud's 3A algorithms—acoustic echo cancellation (AEC), automatic gain control (AGC), and automatic noise suppression (ANS)—were integrated into the speakerphone. The partners aligned hardware and software through shared engineering, collected and cleaned data for extreme outdoor conditions, and optimized models through a three-month weekly feedback loop that produced dozens of algorithm updates. The source reports improved vocal clarity and speech-recognition accuracy, but does not identify model architecture, audio input interfaces, cloud deployment, storage, or processing location. This summary therefore describes the documented co-creation and algorithm integration without asserting an undocumented data pipeline.
